description: This Java source file defines the ModelField class, which models the <field> element in an entity model within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes methods for creating ModelField instances, handling encryption, validation, and XML serialization.

classes.name: ModelField
classes.description: Represents a model of the <field> element in an entity, including properties like name, type, column name, encryption, validation, and XML serialization.
